checklist.notes: Directions and examples are concise, sequenced, and generally accessible at A1.1; the abstract word ‘stable’ is immediately supported by examples.
Four short sections and one tightly bounded language model are manageable in 35 minutes.
The grammar and pronunciation strands connect to a personal monologue, but neither the content nor the M5 allocation enacts the promised exchange/basic-participation outcome.

Safe personal-information production is addressed, but ‘basic participation’ and a communicative exchange are not taught or demonstrated; the M5 objective/title conflict with an allocation containing no interaction or communicative function.
The sequence moves from rule noticing to a model, articulatory guidance, and independent production.

A usable model and rehearsal cycle exist, but the final success check verifies only sound mechanics; it does not let a self-study learner verify present-simple choice/form or successful participation.

Privacy-safe substitution and explicit final-sound/no-extra-vowel guidance are useful without stereotyping; the supplied article-choice observation is not operationalized, which is recorded as a minor limitation.

methods: Inspected only the supplied audit provenance declarations and project-authored authoritative context; no external comparison was performed.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: No external source, corpus, web, or plagiarism search was permitted or performed; this record makes no external originality or copyright claim.

findings.description: The lesson promises ‘basic participation’ and is titled as an exchange, yet it only elicits a four-sentence monologue. The authoritative M5 allocation contains no spoken-interaction or communicative-function target, so the objective and allocation are themselves contradictory.
findings.recommendation: Revise the M5 allocation/objective or add an authorized, genuinely two-turn participation outcome and regenerate the lesson consistently.

findings.description: The terminal checklist can confirm /v/ and /z/ mechanics but provides no observable criterion for correct present-simple meaning/form or communicative success.
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded self-check keyed to routine/fact meaning and subject–verb form, plus a viable participation check; do not add M7 exercises.

findings.description: The authoritative context asks for learner-specific article-choice noticing when relevant, but the personal-information production gives no optional prompt for checking articles.
findings.recommendation: Add a brief conditional article-noticing check only where the learner’s own sentences contain an article, without assuming a universal difficulty.

limitations: AI pedagogical development review only; this is not human review, release approval, certification, or public-release evidence.
